scope: Office workbooks generated or repaired for Excel for Web delivery

rules.description: Carlito is forbidden on WebExcel-facing workbook and producer surfaces.
The workbook default explicit font must be Aptos.
Every explicit workbook font must be in the approved Aptos family.
A changed workbook producer or configuration source must not introduce a forbidden font token.

proof_ceiling: Static OOXML and source-token validation only. Excel for Web visual rendering remains operator or browser-runtime proof.
